description: Actitudes y demandas de los andaluces tras las inundaciones is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Centro de Investigaciones Sociológicas. Attitudes and demands of the Andalusians after the floods. Coverage: Centro de Investigaciones Sociológicas. The portal shows the English title as "Attitudes and demands of the Andalusians after the floods" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Centro de Investigaciones Sociológicas. Its keywords include Votantes genérico, Antonio Maíllo, Lugar de nacimiento, Gobierno autonómico genérico, Escala genérico, Huelva pro. The listing shows 6 download or service links in SHEET, PDF, HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
